title: Monthly Check of Fire Extinguishers
description: Does OSHA require a monthly check of portable fire extinguishers?
body:
Q: Does OSHA require a monthly check of portable fire extinguishers?

A: Yes. The OSHA standard for portable fire extinguishers 19 10.157 requires a monthly check. Each month check for:

* proper location;

* accessibility and visibility;

* intact tamper seal;

* allowable pressure range;

* corrosion or damage to the tank; and

* clogging of the discharge nozzle.
